summary: Iteration 10 testing complete - Country-specific credit packs + promotions, Auto-clean contacts, Delivery rate dashboard, CSV column-mapping wizard. Backend: 34/36 tests passed (2 minor regression test path issues). Frontend: All new features verified working.

minor.issue: /api/admin/reseller-pricing endpoint path was incorrect in test (actual path is /api/reseller/pricing)
/api/admin/sender-id-requests endpoint path was incorrect in test (actual path is /api/admin/sender-ids)

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/credit-packs accepts {country} field - null = global, ISO-2 = country-scoped
GET /api/credits/packs correctly scopes to global + user's country (TZ client sees TZ packs + globals, NOT KE packs)
POST /api/admin/promotions accepts {country} field for country-scoped promos
POST /api/credits/buy validates promo country match - returns 400 'only valid for customers in X' when mismatched
POST /api/numbers/auto-clean runs smart_validate on contacts, charges credits, removes invalids when remove_invalid=true
GET /api/messaging/delivery-report returns comprehensive data: days, total_sent, delivered, failed, delivery_rate, timeline[], failure_reasons[], by_country[]
Failure reasons use plain English (e.g., 'Delivery failed for an unspecified reason') not technical codes
Admin Credit Packs page has Country field in modal with hint 'e.g. TZ, KE, US. Leave empty for a pack visible everywhere'
Admin Promotions page has Country field in modal with hint 'e.g. TZ, KE. Leave empty for any country'
Both admin tables show 'Scope' column displaying 'Global' or ISO-2 code
Client Number Lookup page has 'Auto-clean your contacts' card with scope selector (All/group), cost display, Clean now button

Client Reports page has time-range selector (7/30/90/365), 4 stat cards with color coding, delivery rate line chart, volume stacked bar, failure reasons horizontal bar, by-country table, recent campaigns bar chart
Client Bulk Send has ColumnMapModal that appears when uploaded headers don't include phone/mobile/msisdn - lets user pick phone column and rename others with smart suggestions

success_rate.backend: 94% (34/36 tests passed - 2 minor test path issues)

seed_data_creation: Test credit packs and promotions created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 complete. New features verified: (1) Country-specific credit packs - admin can set country field (null=global, ISO-2=scoped), client wallet shows TZ packs + globals, KE packs filtered out for TZ client; (2) Country-specific promotions - admin can set country field, promo redeem validates country match (400 error if mismatch); (3) Auto-clean contacts - card appears on Number Lookup page when user has contacts, shows scope selector (All/group), cost per number, Clean now button, returns total/valid/invalid/removed/credits_charged; (4) Delivery rate dashboard - Reports page redesigned with time-range selector, 4 stat cards (sent/delivered/failed/rate with color), delivery rate line chart, volume stacked bar, failure reasons horizontal bar (plain English), by-country table with color-coded rate, recent campaigns bar chart; (5) CSV column-mapping wizard - ColumnMapModal in BulkSend.jsx appears when uploaded headers don't include phone/mobile/msisdn, lets user pick phone column and rename others with smart suggestions (First name → first_name, Amount due → amount_owed). HLR lookup remains MOCKED (scaffolded, not live).
